text_gist: Prospect: ~450 employees, 3-person IT team — inside the 200-2,000 seat ICP range.
Buying trigger is a SOC 2 audit in 8 weeks with board pressure for a system of record.
Ticket backlog grows because nobody owns the queue full-time (corroborates the workshop finding).
New-hire access requests stall because approvals are split across inboxes.
Legal requires a completed security questionnaire before signing; has killed deals before.
Prospect runs Zendesk today for ticketing but has no asset tracking, kept in a separate spreadsheet.
Pitched as built for IT teams that outgrew a shared inbox but don't need ServiceNow.
Acme was live in 6 days with no consultants (cross-meeting corroboration).
Small talk about travel — not a claim.
Scheduling a follow-up call — not a claim.
Logistics about who else to loop in — not a claim.
